extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: three-axle tanker truck, approx. 9.0 x 2.5 x 3.3 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors), wheel diameter 1.04 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 6 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the 2 front wheels can also steer around local Z, rear wheels are twin tyres; translucent windows with a simple cab interior (seats, dashboard, steering wheel); no brand, no text, no hazard labels

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
